items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t meet him, but I heard Oscar Pettiford and several of the family bands, the older families.

ctx.x: They felt that New York was fast. It was fast. They just didn’t have the desire to stay there. There were a lot of opportunities there. They wouldn’t stay.
We think about the Marsalis family, but they only have a sextet.
Didn’t want to work Mom too hard.
